title: Pure Metaphys
summary: Metaphys cards only, with staples and an automatic Extra Deck. Metaphys are LIGHT Wyrms that get banished on purpose and pay off a turn later. Metaphys Factor lets you Normal Summon one big Metaphys without tributing, and it gets banished at the End Phase of the next turn. The big Metaphys then fire in your Standby Phase after they're banished. Nephthys shuffles back to search a Metaphys card, Daedalus to banish another Metaphys from the Deck, and Tyrant Dragon to summon one from the hand. Metaphys Ragnarok banishes the top three cards of your Deck and calls a big Metaphys after a hit. Summoned by a Metaphys effect, Daedalus banishes every other Special Summoned monster and Nephthys every Set Spell and Trap. Metaphys Ascension, the newest Trap (2018), discards a Metaphys to draw, banishes one from the Deck, and searches when it's banished itself. Metaphys Armed Dragon counts as Metaphys by name.
main: Metaphys Ragnarok
Tuner: banishes the top three; calls a big Metaphys after a hit.
Metaphys Nephthys
Banishes Set Spells/Traps; searches a Metaphys after it's banished.
Metaphys Daedalus
Banishes other Special Summoned monsters; banishes a Metaphys from the Deck later.
Metaphys Tyrant Dragon
Unaffected by Traps; summons a Metaphys from the hand after it's banished.
Metaphys Decoy Dragon
Newest Pendulum: banishes itself into an attack to revive a Metaphys.
Metaphys Armed Dragon
Level 7 Normal named Metaphys: a free Factor summon and Horus material.
Metaphys Executor
Banishes five Metaphys to summon itself; revives banished ones.
Metaphys Factor
Field Spell: a big Metaphys without tributing; no responses to Metaphys effects.
Asymmetaphys
Banishes a Metaphys to draw; shrinks or flips their monsters on banishes.
Metaphys Ascension
Newest Trap: discards to draw, banishes a Metaphys, searches when banished.
Metaphys Dimension
Revives a banished Metaphys on their summons; banishes a card.
extra: Level 6 Synchro: unaffected, negates or steals by its materials.
